_note: Project assumptions for a synthetic simulation. These are NOT regulatory or legal thresholds.

R1_RAPID_PASS_THROUGH.description: Several incoming transfers from different senders, followed shortly by one large outgoing transfer of a similar amount.

R2_ACTIVITY_SPIKE.description: Account's monthly activity far above its own recent history and above the customer's declared expected activity.

R3_MANY_TO_ONE.description: Many different accounts, with no recent payment relationship, sending funds to the same beneficiary in a short window.

R4_STRUCTURING.description: Repeated cash deposits just below the configurable monitoring threshold.
